intro.text: A figure of the past executed for fraternising with 'unwholesome elements'; an old account defends the Radiants who carried out the execution.
A figure of the past who was found guilty of fraternising with 'unwholesome elements' and executed.

items.text: The Skybreakers cited the other Radiants' condemnation of Kazilah as part of the reason for the growing rift between the orders, which led them to split off before the Recreance.
